name: Verifier
summary: Inspect existing core and Verification Spine evidence, curate in-memory check and failure-memory proposals, and explicitly download a candidate verifier configuration.
notes: Stateless browser editor over same-origin evidence. Specialist verifiers keep their authority; normalized receipts expose missing validators and contradictions. Failure-memory changes use append-only revisions. A downloaded verify.config.json is only a candidate: the browser does not write the root config, execute verification, change Workshop status, or confer CANON.
